description: This source file defines a singleton object 'TvWebViewConfigurator' that provides a method to configure WebView instances for a TV application's user interface. The configuration ensures a consistent 10-foot experience by enabling JavaScript, DOM storage, adjusting cache mode, media playback settings, zoom controls, viewport settings, and WebView focus and background properties.

classes.name: TvWebViewConfigurator
classes.description: A singleton object responsible for configuring WebView objects for use within TV applications, ensuring consistency and optimal user experience.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the provided WebView instance with settings optimized for TV viewing, including JavaScript, DOM storage, cache mode, media playback, zoom controls, viewport, focus, and background color.
